title: Regional Multi-Facility Recall Advisory: Four Concurrent Quality and Safety Incidents
content: Following an internal compliance review spanning four regional distribution centers, Meridian Foods Cooperative is issuing a combined advisory covering four unrelated incidents identified between February 10 and April 22: (1) Lot 7734-A of Cheddar Cheese Snack Bites tested positive for trace levels of Listeria monocytogenes at the Ohio facility; (2) Lot 8821-C of Roasted Almond Trail Mix at the Texas facility was found to contain undeclared tree nuts not listed on the ingredient panel, specifically cashews; (3) Lot 9012-D of Sparkling Citrus Beverage at the Nevada facility showed inconsistent carbonation pressure readings during a routine quality audit, though no health risk has been confirmed; and (4) the Georgia facility's packaging line for Whole Grain Cereal Clusters experienced a labeling error that swapped nutrition panels between two SKUs, Lot 6650-B and Lot 6651-B. Consumers who purchased any of these four products should verify the lot number against the list published on the company website, discontinue consumption of the cheese snack bites and trail mix immediately due to potential health risks, and may continue consuming the beverage and cereal products with caution while corrected labeling is issued within two to three weeks.
